content: Google parent company Alphabet says that its AI investments are leading to a big growth in searches year-over-year, as noted in its Q3 2026 earnings today. “Our AI investments are driving overall Search query growth, including commercial queries,” CEO Sundar Pichai says in a statement. “In fact, our year-over-year query growth rate is the highest it’s been in the last five years.” Alphabet’s consolidated revenues for the quarter were $127.6 billion, up 25 percent year-over-year, with its “Google Search & other” revenues up 12 percent year-over-year. Google Cloud revenue was also up 103 percent year-over-year to $30.7 billion. Alphabet also says it passed 150 million YouTube Music and Premium subscribers globally, though that figure includes trials. The earnings follow a packed quarter for Google, including the announcement of its Gemini 4 Argon frontier model (which it released widely this month); crossing 1 billion monthly users in Gemini; the reveal of the first five Googlebook laptops; a price hike for the Google TV Streamer; renaming NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook; the launch of the Pixel 11 line of smartphones, the new Pixel Watch, and the forthcoming Pixel Tag; and a major shakeup of its top AI leadership that included former DeepMind leader Demis Hassabis stepping into a chair role.
chineseTitle: 谷歌表示其对 AI 的投资正在推动更多搜索
chineseSummary: 谷歌母公司 Alphabet 表示，正如其今天发布的 2026 年第三季度财报中所指出的那样，其人工智能投资正在导致搜索量同比大幅增长。首席执行官 Sundar Pichai 在一份声明中表示：“我们的人工智能投资正在推动整体搜索查询的增长，包括商业查询。” “事实上，我们的同比查询增长率是最高的 [...]
chineseContent: 谷歌母公司 Alphabet 表示，正如其今天发布的 2026 年第三季度财报中所指出的那样，其人工智能投资正在导致搜索量同比大幅增长。 “我们的人工智能投资正在推动整体搜索查询的增长，包括商业查询，”首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊(Sundar Pichai)在一份声明中表示。 “事实上，我们的查询增长率是过去五年来最高的。” Alphabet 本季度综合收入为 1276 亿美元，同比增长 25%，其中“谷歌搜索及其他”收入同比增长 12%。谷歌云收入也同比增长 103%，达到 307 亿美元。 Alphabet 还表示，YouTube Music 和 Premium 的全球订阅用户数量已超过 1.5 亿，不过这个数字包括了试用版。谷歌发布财报之前的季度业绩非常出色，包括发布了 Gemini 4 Argon 前沿模型（本月广泛发布）； Gemini 月用户突破 10 亿；首批五款 Googlebook 笔记本电脑的发布； Google TV Streamer 价格上涨；将 NotebookLM 重命名为 Gemini Notebook；推出 Pixel 11 系列智能手机、新款 Pixel Watch 以及即将推出的 Pixel Tag；其人工智能高层领导层也发生了重大变动，其中包括前 DeepMind 领导者 Demis Hassabis 出任主席。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
